audit.whatIsWrong: Difficulty text never names why the lane is hard: Twilight Shroud makes her unselectable by spells, which is what your whole kit is.
audit.why: W is 20/19/18/17/16s, 350 range, and inside it Akali cannot be selected by spells or attacks; attacking or casting briefly reveals her.
audit.corrected: Difficulty is Shroud uptime — Chains cannot be cast at her until she reveals herself by attacking or casting.

audit.why: LeBlanc spikes at 2, 6 (Mimic 45/35/25s) and first item; Akali spikes at 6 with Perfect Execution (120/90/60s) and again once Shroud is near-permanent at rank 5 (16s).
audit.corrected: Kept; rank-5 Shroud at 16s added to breakdown.cooldowns and to the 2+ items row.

audit.whatIsWrong: The Shuriken Flip mechanic was never stated and breakdown.cooldowns held no number.
audit.why: E flips backward and marks the first enemy or smoke cloud hit; the recast dash only exists if something is marked. Chaining her as she commits removes the return leg. Perfect Execution's recast executes on a threshold, and Assassin's Mark is an empowered auto — the ring wind-up is the tell, not the cast.
audit.corrected: Stated in dosFull[1].d, dontsFull[2].d and the cooldowns field, which now carries 20s/16s Shroud, 16s Flip, 15s Distortion, 45/35/25s Mimic.

audit.whatIsWrong: Trading advice ignored that her Q is a 1.5s cooldown against your 6s Q.
audit.why: Five Point Strike: 1.5s, 550 range, 110/100/90/80/70 energy. Energy, not cooldown, is the limiter inside her range.

audit.whatIsWrong: full phases[N].side read 'Skill' on all seven rows while content win[N] read LeBlanc x6 then Akali.
audit.why: packet.levelChart matches the content layer; the full layer is the outlier, and phases[6].why described LeBlanc winning a row the other layer gives to Akali.
audit.corrected: Full sides aligned to content as one atomic group and phases[6].why rewritten to the Akali verdict.

audit.whatIsWrong: Itemization told you to buy anti-heal 'into his sustain'; Akali's kit text shows no healing.
audit.why: Riot's Akali text contains no heal. The claim is unsourced as well as misgendered.
audit.corrected: Replaced with Zhonya's against Perfect Execution.

edits.before: - Akali Twilight Shroud: matchup-defining — Untargetable inside — hold your CC and burst for when she exits. Check it before every step-up. - W Distortion (return) is the lifeline; chip damage never gets it. - The ult answers fights, not waves.
